name: Durga Mechatronics Pvt. Ltd.
india_angle: Durga Mechatronics has a significant presence in India with an integrated logistics centre in Mumbai and operations across 15+ industrial towns and cities.
summary: Durga Mechatronics Pvt. Ltd. is a distributor of industrial power transmission products, including bearings, control panels, and VFDs, primarily serving the manufacturing industry in India. While their offerings include components that could be used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, their core focus is on broader industrial applications.
